observation_summary: The source map generation for V3 was incorrectly using one-based line numbering, while the specification required zero-based numbering. This caused discrepancies in the generated source map output compared to expected golden values.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves adjusting the computational logic for line numbering in the source map generation process. Specifically, it introduces a conditional offset (lineBaseOffset) to ensure that V3 maps use zero-based indexing while maintaining backward compatibility for V1/V2. This is a correction of the computational strategy for mapping source positions, fitting the Algorithm/Method category.
evidence_used: The fix modifies the calculation of line numbers in SourceMap.java by introducing a lineBaseOffset.
The fix modifies the SourceMapConsumerV3 to adjust line and column numbers by adding 1, correcting the internal representation to match the expected API contract.
The bug report explicitly states that original source line numbers should be zero-based for V3, and the fix implements this logic.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves changing values, it is not a simple initialization error; it is a change to the underlying computational logic (the formula for mapping line numbers) based on the version of the generator.
The fix is internal to the source map generation and consumption logic, not a mismatch in the API signature or contract between two distinct components.
